description: This file defines an abstract class 'GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner' which provides various asynchronous test methods for transaction scenarios involving grains in Orleans. It includes methods for read/write transactions, multi-grain operations, and repeated transactions, utilizing external grain interfaces and FluentAssertions for validation.

classes.name: GoldenPathTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: An abstract class providing test methods for transaction scenarios involving grains, including read/write, multi-grain, and repeated transactions.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read-only transaction on a single grain, asserting all results are zero.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a single grain, adding a delta and verifying the updated values.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write operation across multiple grains, setting each to an expected value.

methods.name: MultiGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a combined read/write transaction across multiple grains, verifying expected values after operations.

methods.name: RepeatGrainReadWriteTransaction
methods.description: Repeats read/write operations on grains multiple times, verifying the expected accumulated value.

methods.name: MultiWriteToSingleGrainTransaction
methods.description: Performs multiple concurrent writes to a single grain and verifies the final state.

methods.name: RWRWTest
methods.description: Performs a read-modify-write sequence on grains, verifying the expected final state.

methods.name: WRWRTest
methods.description: Performs a write-read-write sequence on grains, verifying the expected final state.
